description: Experiment D, READ load (no LLM): closed-loop clients send GET /v1/graph/nodes/{nodeId}/neighbors?depth=1&limit=50 and GET /v1/evidence/{evidenceId} for the committed IDs in load-tests/read-ids-d.txt (benchmark-v1 and the Phase 14 smoke records) at 1, 5, 10 and 20 concurrent clients, 120 s per level, at most 600 requests per level, a 60 s pause between levels, after one ID check request per listed ID. Measures attempted and completed requests, throughput, p50/p95/p99 over all attempts and over 'ok' answers, class counts (ok, not-found, throttled, overloaded, timeout, other), the query, evidence and graph services' desired and running tasks every 15 s, and CloudWatch ALB, ECS, DynamoDB and Neptune series. Runs under the deployed limits (planned deviation 5; API throttle 5 per second burst 10): throttling at the higher levels is a result; CPU scale-out of the graph or evidence service is not expected. First to drop if the cost plan needs it (decision 2).
datasetSnapshot: dblp-2026-11-01 (DBLP XML with dblp.dtd), subset rule dblp-subset-v1 (datasets/dataset-manifest.yaml); the Phase 14 graph run:v1:f2625d504b12749389cf4f5b1a26aed4 in Neptune and DynamoDB

resourceLimits.terraformSource: infra/terraform/environments/course (api_throttling_rate_limit 5, api_throttling_burst_limit 10; decision 3); infra/terraform/modules/runtime/autoscaling.tf (evidence and graph CPU target tracking, max service_max_count 2); hard caps in load-tests/query-load.sh (600 requests per level, at most 20 clients)

notes: APPROVAL: the human signs this exact file at D9 with the line APPROVED-MANIFEST-SHA256: HEX64 in docs/agent-runs/phase-15/approvals.md; any change is a new sha256 and a new approval. Its live run is the first dropped if the cost plan needs it (decision 2: the manifest then stays unsigned). Run in the terminal where SCHOLARCHAIN_SERVICE_API_KEY is exported. COST (estimate): about $0.05 to $0.10: at most 2,400 level requests + 29 ID-check requests; Neptune I/O about 0.22 M x $0.20 per million (100 I/Os per depth-1, limit-50 read assumed, unverified; 6a), DynamoDB and API Gateway under $0.01, the metric export about $0.01; costBoundUsd 0.2. DURATION: query-load.sh's own deadline about 1,740 s for these arguments (4 x (120 + 15 + 15 + 150 + 60) + 300); maxDurationSeconds 2,400. METRICS: AWS/ApplicationELB TargetResponseTime, RequestCount and HTTPCode_Target_5XX_Count with LoadBalancer and TargetGroup seen in account; HTTPCode_ELB_5XX_Count docs only (cited: not listed because no ALB 5xx happened in the retention window; same metric as the alb-5xx alarm, infra/terraform/modules/observability/alarms.tf; ALB metrics page https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/load-balancer-cloudwatch-metrics.html, not re-read in 6b); ALB placeholders resolve only after D4 (new outputs); AWS/ECS series seen in account; DynamoDB ConsumedReadCapacityUnits and SuccessfulRequestLatency (evidence-bundle, GetItem and Query) seen in account; ThrottledRequests and ReadThrottleEvents docs only (cited: published only when a request is throttled; DynamoDB metrics page https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/metrics-dimensions.html, not re-read in 6b); AWS/Neptune series seen in account; AWS/ApiGateway dropped (ApiId is the first label of the API host; no runner placeholder). LIMITATIONS known in advance: 3 of 29 listed IDs are evidence reads (about 10 % of requests; an evidence item with several windows needs ?window=, 6a); the read-ID list was taken from the Phase 10 export and the Phase 14 smoke records: which IDs answer 200 on the live graph is shown by the --preflight ID check (D9a) and the run's id-check.csv; CloudWatch periods that span a level boundary are marked boundary.
